title: Phish Live 2026: Here’s Where to Watch the Band’s Madison Square Garden Concert Series Live Online
summary: The jam band is set to play five shows at MSG in New York — watch every concert live in 4K Ultra HD at home.

This summer, Vermont-based rock band Phish is on tour throughout the Midwest, East Coast and Mountain West. This week, the band is set to perform a five-concert series at Madison Square Garden in New York City . With dates starting on Wednesday (July 22) and going until the following Wednesday (July 29), the shows promise to be filled with immersive music experiences and high-energy performances.
